title: Pyrolysis - Charcoal Piles
description: Burn log piles into charcoal, and removes lava buckets as fuel.
body: Made as a part of [LITHIC](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lithic) Burying a 3x3x3 pile of wood with a campfire on top (placed directly below the player), and quickly closing the pile converts the pile to charcoal over the span of a day. Interrupting the process will make all the existing coal blocks catch fire. Disables lava buckets as a fuel source. _**LINKS:**_ ___ [](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/legendary-portals)[](https://modrinth.com/project/improved-portals) [](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/scrofae)
